So trigger extra 30% increase => contribute full wallet? But also conserve rule: if wallet below 30% of initial (30), not the case (98.86). So must contribute full wallet (or at least 80% + extra 30%?). Constitution: baseline 80%; if avg <30% increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. That means contribution = baseline 80% + extra 30% = 110% of wallet? Can't exceed wallet, so full wallet. So contribute full wallet 98.86. Also need broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1? Broadcast at round 1,6,11? Actually they did at round1 and 6. Should broadcast at round 11? It's every 5 rounds thereafter: rounds 1,6,11,16. So round 11 we should have broadcast but they didn't. Now round 12 not broadcast. So actions: contribute full wallet, maybe also private praise? Identify agents contributed >=60% of wallet this round. Contributions: Resident1 0, Resident2 10, Resident4 60, Resident5 36.9, Resident6 0. Resident4 contributed 60 which is >60% of its wallet? Unknown wallet of Resident4 but likely less than 100. Assume yes. So praise Resident4. Also can punish free riders: need two consecutive rounds <10% endowment. Resident2 contributed 10 each round, that's exactly threshold 10% (free rider threshold is 10 units). Not below. No punish.

Thus actions: contribute amount 98.86, private_message to Resident4 praising. Only one physical and one communication.
